instruction: Candid documentary full shot at eye-level from the side in a motion capture studio featuring a red carpet and white pillars. The bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing left in profile. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands behind him on the right, facing left, extending her right arm to touch his back with her hand. The room is lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet and dark red screens.
